description: 在飯店遇到房間太吵、太髒、冷氣或熱水壞掉等問題時，能清楚描述狀況，禮貌提出要求換房、維修或補償。

sentences.en: Good evening. I'm afraid I need to speak to the manager about my room.
sentences.zh: 晚安，不好意思，我需要和經理談談我的房間問題。
sentences.tips: 「I'm afraid...」是英語中非常禮貌的抱怨開場，語氣遠比直接說「This is bad」委婉，在飯店投訴場合特別有效。

sentences.en: I'm the duty manager. What seems to be the problem, sir?
sentences.zh: 我是值班經理。先生，請問有什麼問題嗎？
sentences.tips: 遇到問題要求升級處理，說 I'd like to speak to the manager 或 Could I speak to someone in charge?，比重複抱怨更有效。

sentences.en: The room you assigned me is right next to the elevator, and the noise is constant throughout the night.
sentences.zh: 你們分配給我的房間就在電梯旁邊，整晚噪音不斷。
sentences.tips: 飯店投訴時，保持冷靜並具體描述問題，比情緒化抱怨更能獲得令人滿意的解決方案。

sentences.en: I'm very sorry to hear that. Unfortunately, all our standard rooms are fully booked tonight.
sentences.zh: 聽到這個消息我很抱歉。很不巧，我們所有的標準房今晚都客滿了。
sentences.tips: 飯店投訴時，保持冷靜並具體描述問題，比情緒化抱怨更能獲得令人滿意的解決方案。

sentences.en: I understand, but I really can't sleep under these conditions. Could you check if there's any other option?
sentences.zh: 我明白，但在這種情況下我真的無法入睡。你可以查一下是否有其他選擇嗎？
sentences.tips: 提出要求時，Could you...? 或 Is it possible to...? 比直接命令（Fix this!）更禮貌，也更容易獲得正面回應。

sentences.en: Let me see... We do have a quiet suite available on a higher floor. However, there would be a small upgrade fee.
sentences.zh: 讓我看看... 我們在較高的樓層確實有一間安靜的套房。不過，會有一筆小小的升級費用。
sentences.tips: 飯店投訴時，保持冷靜並具體描述問題，比情緒化抱怨更能獲得令人滿意的解決方案。

sentences.en: Since the noise issue is not my fault, I would appreciate it if you could waive the fee.
sentences.zh: 既然噪音問題不是我的錯，如果您能免除這筆費用，我會非常感激。
sentences.tips: 「I would appreciate it if you could...」是最有禮貌的委婉請求句型，適合在需要對方採取行動時使用，語氣不強迫。

sentences.en: You're right. As a gesture of goodwill, we'll upgrade you to the suite at no extra charge.
sentences.zh: 您說得對。為了表示誠意，我們將為您免費升級到套房。
sentences.tips: 服務業常說 as a gesture of goodwill（表達誠意）提供免費補償，這是緩和客訴的常見專業用語。

sentences.en: I need to speak to someone about a problem with my room.
sentences.zh: 我需要找人談談我房間的問題。
sentences.tips: 飯店投訴時，保持冷靜並具體描述問題，比情緒化抱怨更能獲得令人滿意的解決方案。

sentences.en: I'm not happy with the condition of the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 我對浴室的狀況不太滿意。
sentences.tips: 飯店投訴時，保持冷靜並具體描述問題，比情緒化抱怨更能獲得令人滿意的解決方案。

sentences.en: The air conditioning unit is making a strange noise.
sentences.zh: 空調機正在發出奇怪的噪音。
sentences.tips: 飯店投訴時，保持冷靜並具體描述問題，比情緒化抱怨更能獲得令人滿意的解決方案。

sentences.en: Is it possible to change to a different room?
sentences.zh: 有可能換到另一間房間嗎？
sentences.tips: 提出要求時，Could you...? 或 Is it possible to...? 比直接命令（Fix this!）更禮貌，也更容易獲得正面回應。

sentences.en: Could you send someone to fix the shower?
sentences.zh: 可以派個人來修理淋浴設備嗎？
sentences.tips: 提出要求時，Could you...? 或 Is it possible to...? 比直接命令（Fix this!）更禮貌，也更容易獲得正面回應。

sentences.en: I would appreciate some compensation for the inconvenience.
sentences.zh: 對於造成的不便，我希望得到一些補償。
sentences.tips: 「I would appreciate it if you could...」是最有禮貌的委婉請求句型，適合在需要對方採取行動時使用，語氣不強迫。

sentences.en: This is not the standard I expected from your hotel.
sentences.zh: 這不是我對貴飯店所期待的標準。
sentences.tips: 飯店投訴時，保持冷靜並具體描述問題，比情緒化抱怨更能獲得令人滿意的解決方案。

vocabulary.example_en: I don't want to complain, but the service was very slow.
vocabulary.example_zh: 我不想抱怨，但服務非常緩慢。

vocabulary.example_en: The room was in poor condition when we checked in.
vocabulary.example_zh: 我們入住時房間狀況不佳。

vocabulary.example_en: They offered to upgrade our room for free.
vocabulary.example_zh: 他們提出免費為我們的房間升級。

vocabulary.example_en: The hotel offered us a free dinner as compensation.
vocabulary.example_zh: 飯店提供我們免費晚餐作為補償。

vocabulary.example_en: The hotel's fitness facility was closed for maintenance.
vocabulary.example_zh: 飯店的健身設施因維護而關閉。

vocabulary.example_en: We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
vocabulary.example_zh: 對於所造成的任何不便，我們致上歉意。

vocabulary.example_en: The free drink was a nice gesture from the manager.
vocabulary.example_zh: 免費飲料是經理的好意表示。

grammar_highlights.title: 有禮貌地表達不滿：I'm afraid... / I'm not very happy with...
grammar_highlights.description: 在英語中，抱怨時常用 I'm afraid... 或 I'm not very happy with... 來客氣地表達不滿，比直接說 This is bad. 更禮貌。
grammar_highlights.example_en: I'm afraid the room is too noisy for me.
grammar_highlights.example_zh: 我怕這間房間對我來說太吵了。

grammar_highlights.title: 提出請求時使用 Could you...? 或 Is it possible to...?
grammar_highlights.description: 在提出要求（如換房、維修）時，使用 Could you...? 或 Is it possible to...? 會比直接命令（Fix this.）更有禮貌，更容易被接受。
grammar_highlights.example_en: Is it possible to get a room with a better view?
grammar_highlights.example_zh: 有可能換到景觀好一點的房間嗎？

grammar_highlights.title: 用 I would appreciate it if... 委婉地提出期望
grammar_highlights.description: 當你希望對方採取某種行動時，用 I would appreciate it if... 來表達，語氣非常客氣且有禮。
grammar_highlights.example_en: I would appreciate it if you could look into this matter.
grammar_highlights.example_zh: 如果您能調查一下這件事，我將非常感激。
